{"test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection1", "test_code": "#nullable enable\nusing System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    private const string TestSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TempProject\n{\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        None = 0,\n        First = 1,\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class MyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public MyEnum Value { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_DefaultTarget_AppliesExcludeFromCodeCoverage()\n    {\n        (GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, Compilation output) = await RunGeneratorAsync(Array.Empty<string>());\n\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(output.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult enumFormatterSource = Assert.Single(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.SyntaxTree.ToString().Contains(\"MyEnumFormatter\"));\n        string generatedText = enumFormatterSource.SyntaxTree.ToString();\n        Assert.Contains(\"#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK\", generatedText);\n        Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", generatedText);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterType = FindTypeByName(output.Assembly.GlobalNamespace, \"MyEnumFormatter\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterType);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            formatterType!.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    [Theory]\n    [InlineData(\"NETSTANDARD2_0\")]\n    [InlineData(\"NETFRAMEWORK\")]\n    public async Task EnumFormatter_NetStandard20OrNetFramework_CompilesAndOmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverage(string preprocessorSymbol)\n    {\n        (GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult, Compilation output) = await RunGeneratorAsync(new[] { preprocessorSymbol });\n\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(output.GetDiagnostics(), d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        GeneratedSourceResult enumFormatterSource = Assert.Single(\n            runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.SyntaxTree.ToString().Contains(\"MyEnumFormatter\"));\n        string generatedText = enumFormatterSource.SyntaxTree.ToString();\n        Assert.Contains(\"#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK\", generatedText);\n        Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", generatedText);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterType = FindTypeByName(output.Assembly.GlobalNamespace, \"MyEnumFormatter\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterType);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(\n            formatterType!.GetAttributes(),\n            a => a.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<(GeneratorDriverRunResult RunResult, Compilation Output)> RunGeneratorAsync(string[] preprocessorSymbols)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> netRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references = netRefs.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: preprocessorSymbols);\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(TestSource, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new ISourceGenerator[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out _);\n        return (driver.GetRunResult(), output);\n    }\n\n    private static INamedTypeSymbol? FindTypeByName(INamespaceSymbol ns, string name)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in ns.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            INamedTypeSymbol? found = FindInType(type, name);\n            if (found is not null)\n            {\n                return found;\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n        {\n            INamedTypeSymbol? found = FindTypeByName(childNs, name);\n            if (found is not null)\n            {\n                return found;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    private static INamedTypeSymbol? FindInType(INamedTypeSymbol type, string name)\n    {\n        if (type.Name == name)\n        {\n            return type;\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in type.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            INamedTypeSymbol? found = FindInType(nested, name);\n            if (found is not null)\n            {\n                return found;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return null;\n    }\n}\n"}
